```{r}
#| include: true
#| label: tbl-scNBC
#| tbl-cap: "Site Classification. Source: National Building Code of Canada NBC (2020)"

SC=c("A","B","C","D","E","F")
Description=c(
  "Hard rocks",#A,>1500 m/s
  "Rocks",#B,760 to 1500 m/s
  "Very dense soils or soft rocks",#C 360 to 760 m/s
  "Stiff soils", #D 180 to 360 m/s
  "Soft soils",#E 140-180 m/s
  "Other soils")#F

Vs30=c(
  ">1500 [m/s]",
  ">760-1500 [m/s]",
  ">360-760 [m/s]",
  ">180-360 [m/s]",
  ">140-360 [m/s]",
  "<=140 [m/s]")

DT <- data.table::data.table(
  SC=SC,
  Description=Description,
  Vs30=Vs30)

TBL <- DT |> buildTable(library="flextable",font.size.body = FONT.SIZE.BODY,font.size.header = FONT.SIZE.HEADER)
TBL <- flextable::set_table_properties(TBL,layout = "autofit")

TBL
```
